description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::time::civil_time module, testing construction, formatting, parsing, arithmetic, comparison, and edge cases of civil time classes like CivilSecond, CivilMinute, CivilHour, CivilDay, CivilMonth, and CivilYear.

classes.name: absl::CivilSecond
classes.description: Represents a civil second with fields for year, month, day, hour, minute, and second.

classes.name: absl::CivilMinute
classes.description: Represents a civil minute, derived from CivilSecond, with minute precision.

classes.name: absl::CivilHour
classes.description: Represents a civil hour, derived from CivilMinute, with hour precision.

classes.name: absl::CivilDay
classes.description: Represents a civil day, derived from CivilHour, with day precision.

classes.name: absl::CivilMonth
classes.description: Represents a civil month, derived from CivilDay, with month precision.

classes.name: absl::CivilYear
classes.description: Represents a civil year, derived from CivilMonth, with year precision.

classes.name: absl::Weekday
classes.description: Enumeration of weekdays used in civil time calculations.

methods.name: absl::FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats a civil time object into a string representation.

methods.name: absl::ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses a string into a civil time object, strict version.

methods.name: absl::ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Parses a string into a civil time object, lenient version allowing more flexible formats.

methods.name: absl::GetWeekday
methods.description: Returns the weekday for a given civil time.

methods.name: absl::NextWeekday
methods.description: Returns the next civil day matching a specified weekday.

methods.name: absl::PrevWeekday
methods.description: Returns the previous civil day matching a specified weekday.
